result.content: {"reasoning": "The narrative is logically tight and seamlessly structured. The lede headline recommends Brisk-S low reasoning with 1 retry (J) conditionally due to clearing the 97% gate by only 0.1 points (97.1%), with Brisk-S high reasoning 1 retry (L) as fallback. Each claim block's visual and tabular data directly match the statements without internal contradiction: Claim c1 accurately shows J ($0.30) and L ($0.63) as the cheapest passing arms; Claim c2 illustrates the confidence intervals crossing the 97% line; and Claim c3 clearly verifies that all Nano-XS configurations fail the gate. All numbers align consistently across the options table and full results.", "criteria_scores": {"report_writer.coherent_story": "5"}}

result.content: {"reasoning": "The first screen immediately gives the reader a complete executive picture. The headline states what to do/what is unresolved ('Pass rate is bought with cost, and nothing declared says what a point is worth. Brisk-S at low reasoning with one retry is our lean, but the pick is the owner's'). The lede and decision block explain why (steep frontier tradeoffs, cheap Nano-XS gains vs. Atlas-M diminishing returns, and specific price-per-point flip bands) and detail the primary risks/caveats ('Confidence: Low', lack of target pass-rate/cost criteria, best-of-many selection effect, and latency exposure). Claim c1 immediately follows with exact frontier step costs. The reader is exceptionally well served.", "criteria_scores": {"report_writer.first_screen": "5"}}

What is tangled... Next. No arm can be shipped as a gate-clearing choice today...'), and first claim, the reader immediately knows what is unresolved and what to do (keep existing baseline, do not ship any arm, re-run Brisk-S low with retry with per-task latency and larger sample), why (Brisk-S low with retry misses pass rate by 1% on two tasks and latency is only measured overall, while others clearly fail gates), and the main risks/limitations (best-of-18 selection bias, lack of per-task latency metrics, lack of a control baseline).","criteria_scores":{"report_writer.first_screen":"5"}}
